name: superfile
description: Pretty fancy and modern terminal file manager with advanced features, customizable hotkeys, and intuitive interface design

superfile.description: Modern terminal file manager with advanced navigation, file operations, customizable hotkeys, and beautiful interface
superfile.usage:
superfile # Launch file manager
superfile /path/to/directory # Open specific directory
superfile --print-last-dir # Print last directory on exit
superfile --fix-hotkeys # Fix hotkey configuration
superfile path-list # Show config paths
